data.one_liner: Plugin for scanning barcodes and QR codes on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to launch the device camera and return scanned codes. Supports continuous scanning via a stream and customizable overlay colors and flash icon.
use_when: You need to scan barcodes or QR codes in a Flutter app
You want a lightweight, native implementation without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need advanced image processing or ML features beyond scanning
You prefer a fully declarative widget-based scanner
strengths: Native Android/iOS implementation, no external dependencies
Supports continuous scanning and customizable UI
weaknesses: Requires manual iOS Swift setup and pod install
data.setup_notes: Add camera usage description to Info.plist, set iOS deployment target 12, Swift 5, run pod install in ios folder

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a widget-based scanner with more configuration options and automatic permission handling

alternatives.name: qr_code_scanner_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Similar API but includes continuous scanning and better iOS support

data.minimal_example:
import 'package:flutter_barcode_scanner/flutter_barcode_scanner.dart';

String barcode = await FlutterBarcodeScanner.scanBarcode('#ff6666', 'Cancel', true, ScanMode.DEFAULT);
